editions.title: The reference farm
editions.summary: The current farm, data explorer and independent review baseline, preserved as an edition.

changes.title: Preserved gameplay
changes.description: The deployed reference gameplay and prior progress. Edition routing and navigation are compatibility adaptations; no new audio is added to v1.

editions.title: Editions and a quieter farm
editions.summary: Choose independent editions, follow feedback into changes, and optionally add gentle music and sound effects.

changes.title: Independent editions
changes.description: Each edition has its own saved farm, assumptions, branches, conversations and settings.

changes.title: Feedback to evolution
changes.description: Original reviews retain their tested builds. New changes link to evidence without claiming unrelated findings are fixed.

changes.title: Optional gentle audio
changes.description: Original quiet music and soft effects start muted, with separate controls and per-edition preferences.

changes.title: Keyboard voice typing
changes.description: The main message field includes a hint for device-keyboard dictation where available. FarmTact does not record or upload speech.

changes.title: Open feedback: delivery and margin explanations
changes.description: Buyer allocation, policy selection and margin explanations remain areas for improvement. These original reviews are retained; this edition does not claim those gameplay findings are resolved.

editions.title: Seven perspectives, one farm
editions.summary: Seven farming advisors connect demand, weather, market, production, supply chain, profit and planning. Market separates sourced community reactions from demand.

changes.title: Seven advisors with distinct responsibilities
changes.description: Follows Sumin Lee’s seven-role model. Idris becomes Market; Lina joins Supply Chain; Asha concludes the council.

changes.title: Evidence checks without a critic persona
changes.description: Numerical and evidence validation remain automatic. Incomplete or rejected council findings withhold acceptance while computed alternatives remain inspectable.

changes.title: Honest community evidence
changes.description: A provenance-aware, read-only Market panel distinguishes produce reactions from quantities and prices. No social feed is connected yet; missing observations are shown explicitly.

editions.title: Room to ask a question
editions.summary: The seven-agent farm with a usable mobile message field and device-keyboard voice guidance on its own row.

changes.title: Readable mobile dialogue controls
changes.description: Corrects the narrow message field caused by the voice-typing hint. The hint now wraps below the field, with 44-pixel input and send controls. Verified at 360, 390, 430 and 1280 pixels.

changes.title: Seven-agent experience retained
changes.description: Demand, Weather, Market, Production, Supply Chain, Profit and Planner keep distinct responsibilities. Community feeds remain explicitly unconnected. Earlier editions retain their saved state and images.

editions.title: Follow a delivery decision
editions.summary: Trace a dated supply gap into frozen strategies, distinctive crops, clearer optional sound and sourced News context.

changes.title: A playable decision with traceable evidence
changes.description: Inspect the actual booked-order records, edit exact assumptions, run three numerical strategies and compare one policy at a time. Biological maturity and calculation waiting use separate clocks. Saved results retain their own baseline and mission.

changes.title: Recognizable original crops
changes.description: Eighteen revised illustrations distinguish leaf shapes, stems and growth habits across ten crop profiles and four stage sequences. Independent compact-size and grayscale reviews prompted specific mustard, kale and pak choi revisions.

changes.title: Optional sound with test and retry
changes.description: A stronger original mix, separate channels and a test tone address the previously quiet audio. Completion, shortfall, withheld acceptance and failure have distinct cues. Every visit starts silent. Signal/browser review is recorded; physical-device listening remains untested.

changes.title: News supports the seven-agent council
changes.description: Browse cached SFA and regional headline metadata with separate source dates and explicit missing future-event coverage. A supporting News scout freezes evidence for decisions and paid advisor interpretation; headlines never change farm quantities automatically. Reddit and restricted community sources remain visibly unavailable.

changes.title: Earlier editions preserved after hosting review
changes.description: Retain separate Fly instances: equal-capacity configurations offer essentially no price saving, and cheaper shared sizes require unverified capacity reductions. Earlier images, sessions and saved records remain independent.

editions.title: More crops, one shared home
editions.summary: Explore garlic chives and sawtooth coriander with primary research and original illustrations. Independent editions share one smaller Fly host while retaining their own farms and progress.

changes.title: Two researched crop species
changes.description: Garlic chives and sawtooth coriander join the twelve-profile crop atlas, with local NParks background, four primary research papers, careful name matching and explicit evidence gaps. They are knowledge profiles; the four-crop synthetic planning fixture is unchanged.

changes.title: Distinctive original botanical illustrations
changes.description: Flat, upright garlic-chive leaves and the toothed sawtooth-coriander rosette have original SVG illustrations. Responsive, keyboard, alias-search and evidence-link checks cover all twelve profiles.

changes.title: Independent editions on one smaller host
changes.description: Pinned edition images run in isolated containers on one shared 4-vCPU/4-GB Fly Machine with one persistent volume. Each edition keeps its own database, cache and progress. New releases reuse the shared host. Shared operational limits remain enforced.

editions.title: V7 · Playable farm council
editions.summary: A guided farm council study: ask for a plan, reserve a bed, test an order and inspect the numerical consequences. Compare three optional discussion layouts in an isolated saved study.

changes.title: One clear starting action
changes.description: Start a guided synthetic decision with one numerical planning action. Plain labels, visible units, saved progress and optional research controls support first-time exploration. Try /v7/research.

changes.title: Conversation produces reviewable scenario changes
changes.description: Scripted dialogue proposes dated bed reservations, order confirmation and labour ceilings. Explicit edits create frozen versions; local numerical tools calculate comparisons. Main-farm progress is separate and real operations remain disabled.

changes.title: Evidence, challenges and optional actual advisers
changes.description: Inspect assumptions, keep challenges unresolved or reject recommendations, and choose only a feasible current simulation. Optional explicit DeepSeek interpretation uses the frozen result and shows validation status. Three research layouts are available for comparison.

editions.title: V8 · Recorded seasons and adviser evidence
editions.summary: Advance a persistent synthetic farm season, trace orders and harvest lots across replans, inspect versioned model experiments, and ask advisers about bounded frozen evidence. Actual farm operations remain disabled.

changes.title: Recorded synthetic seasons
changes.description: Create an execution world from an accepted plan. Advance the recorded clock, inspect tasks, inventory, demand, cash and append-only events, and replan future work with stable crop-cycle and harvest-lot identities.

changes.title: Explicit planning and model experiments
changes.description: Weighted scenario utilities, worst-case fill objectives, FEFO order allocation, resource reservations and independent synthetic training/evaluation cohorts expose assumptions and limitations. Synthetic results do not establish real-farm predictive accuracy.

changes.title: Bounded adviser evidence
changes.description: Separate Council execution, evidence and decision status. Typed server-owned facts, exact mission lookup aliases, bounded conversation context, frozen research references and preserved rejected attempts improve inspectability; qualitative truth remains unverified.

changes.title: Durable research and application state
changes.description: Versioned research history, receipt-safe mutations, separate numerical and provider worker lanes, bounded retries and cancellation, source provenance and explicit retention controls strengthen the synthetic research workflow.

editions.title: V9 · Readable adviser facts and precise context
editions.summary: Advisers retain metric meaning, use bounded role evidence and clearer policy context, and show exact frozen facts in mission Council, conversations and research. Prior editions and their trial records remain unchanged.

changes.title: Metric meaning survives short references
changes.description: Mission references preserve canonical names, labels, units and strategy identity. The Council receives the actual required/advisory selection policy and explicit external-source availability. Unsupported role findings remain visible and cannot spend format-repair requests.

changes.title: Bounded, relevant numerical answers
changes.description: Conversation context filters every comparison segment and admits available baseline/scenario/delta groups together. Numerical answers require typed evidence. Absent-source Council specialists abstain; direct numerical questions remain answerable from their frozen facts.

changes.title: Authoritative facts visible beside interpretations
changes.description: Mission Council, saved conversations and research adviser responses display code-rendered quantities and dates, with clear unavailable and unsupported states. AI prose remains qualitative interpretation; it never supplies authoritative values or authorizes real farm operations.

editions.title: V10 · Fulfillment checks and clean abstentions
editions.summary: Supply receives explicit booked fulfillment status and rejects known contradictory full-delivery claims. Council specialists without external evidence receive an absence-only context. All earlier editions and trial failures are preserved.

changes.title: Booked fulfillment reconciles with frozen quantities
changes.description: Requested, delivered and shortfall quantities accompany a code-derived fulfillment status. Explicit claims of full booked fulfillment fail when the frozen plan has a shortfall. Semantic rejection cannot consume a format-only repair.

changes.title: Absent-source specialists give clean abstentions
changes.description: Weather and Market Council turns with absent external observations receive only their absence boundary, with empty reference and action arrays required. Frozen records remain durable and numerical direct questions retain their facts.

editions.title: Guided farm production planning
editions.summary: Plan from farm records, simulate progress and compare keeping a saved schedule with replanning under identical demand and seasonal changes. Review grounded Council advice explicitly. Editions now appear newest first.

changes.title: One guided production mission
changes.description: Connect records, numerical schedules, the farm board, an explicit Council checkpoint, synthetic execution and future-only replanning.

changes.title: Fair adaptation and bounded advice
changes.description: Compare retained and reoptimized schedules under the same changed conditions; preserve executed work, bookings and inventory. Council selects validated facts and bounded rationales.

changes.title: Newest editions first
changes.description: The starting screen and version switcher sort numbered editions in reverse chronological order.
